primaryGeneralCurrentControl.title: MCAF7.0.2 section5.1.6 Current loop tuning
primaryGeneralCurrentControl.notes: Manufacturer documentation stresses stability/overshoot, sample-to-output delay and testing. Loop update/PWM frequency is not closed-loop bandwidth.

derivedVoltageHeadroom.formula: Vrequired=R*i+L*di_dt+Kf*v_gap; remaining supply voltage bounds current slew.
derivedVoltageHeadroom.interpretation: Full3.5 A sinusoid at3kHz is impossible on24 V for3mH;1.5-3kHz amplifier bandwidth must be a small-signal claim.

derivedSwitchingRippleCheck.assumptions: Simple ideal unipolar switching around static hold; actual modulation/carrier cancellation/contact dynamics may change it. This is not an ACK measurement or model-simulation result.
derivedSwitchingRippleCheck.importance: Native study uses averaged voltage and has no PWM ripple. Low ripple and process/measurement force bandwidth need physical validation.

prototypeVerification: Measure current step and small-signal frequency response around2.5 A at the actual24 V bus and4ohm/3mH cold/hot coil; include command-path latency, jitter, ripple, overshoot and voltage clipping. Fit identified response including delay, then repeat native normal-force tests.
